tapeLine: US stocks rose Tuesday: the S&P 500 gained 0.58% to a record 7,818.93, its first close above 7,800, the Nasdaq Composite 0.45% to a record 27,599.79 and the Dow 253.38 points (0.49%) to 51,521.28, per CNBC and Yahoo Finance. Wednesday morning the 10-year Treasury yield was 5.30% (+1.4 bp), the 2-year 4.80% and the 30-year 5.68%, per FXStreet. Futures were mixed: Dow -0.06%, S&P 500 +0.06%, Nasdaq -0.16%.
matters:
Stocks closed at records on Tuesday, led by chipmakers, as yields eased, per CNBC. Wednesday morning yields rebounded and futures were mixed, per FXStreet.

The September FOMC minutes are due at 2:00 p.m. ET Wednesday; the next FOMC meeting is 28 October. Expectations for an October hike fell to 22.1% from 64.2% a week earlier, per CME FedWatch as cited by Admiral Markets.

Invalidation: the tone of the minutes, and whether the 10-year holds above 5.3%.
alsoOnTape: Oil and gold are not carried: no dated, consistent levels were found this session.
overnight: US Tuesday close — S&P 500 +0.58% to 7,818.93 (record), Nasdaq +0.45% to 27,599.79 (record), Dow +0.49% to 51,521.28, per CNBC and Yahoo Finance.
Futures Wednesday — Dow -0.06%, S&P 500 +0.06%, Nasdaq -0.16%, per FXStreet.

Fed — September minutes at 2:00 p.m. ET Wednesday; FOMC 28 October. Odds of an October hike 22.1% per CME FedWatch, as cited by Admiral Markets.

regime.tag: Stocks at records on Tuesday; 10-year yield near its 52-week high.
regime.sizing: Equities are absorbing high yields; Wednesday's FOMC minutes are the next evidence.

secondOrder: Equities made records on a day yields eased, then yields rebounded Wednesday morning. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: Yesterday's regime read was that equities were absorbing higher yields. Stocks rose again Tuesday to records, per CNBC.
Yesterday's brief listed whether the 10-year keeps rising above 5.3% as a test. It eased Tuesday, then was back at 5.30% Wednesday morning, per FXStreet; unresolved.
Wednesday's FOMC minutes and the 28 October FOMC have not yet occurred.
